_meta.purpose: Reserved X-User-Id values and the pinned clock for the F-005 API suite. Separate from users.json so the F-001 suite's accounts keep their own zone/first-report history — ADR-010 makes account.timezone first-report-wins, so two suites sharing an account id would make the zone depend on which ran first.
_meta.rule: All destructive assertions are scoped to tasks whose title starts with 'qaapi5-' and to these user ids only. No unscoped global mutations. Other QA agents must NOT send these ids.

QAAPI5-U2.role: second account — caller-scoping probes on the two brand-new write paths (restore, reminder-ack) and on parent_id validation: owns rows U1's requests must see as 404

QAAPI5-U3.role: zone-experiment account — first-report-wins and PATCH /account cases, kept apart so no other case depends on its zone history

QAAPI5-U4.role: steps-only account (AC-35) — every parent excluded from the collection on screen; kept clean so collectionTasks-vs-state.tasks assertions are not polluted

clock.t0_note: A Wednesday. AC-23's worked example is 'due Wednesday, rule weekly on Monday and Thursday', so a Wednesday anchor makes the forward-alignment case the ordinary one rather than a contrivance. Chosen once and derived from everywhere: L-023 records a harness that pinned the seam and left the fixtures on the wall clock, and 771 tests were green because the view read the wrong clock.
clock.dst_note: AC-44's DST outcome — 'a daily 09:00 repeat rolled across a DST boundary is still due at 09:00 wall-clock'. US DST ends 2026-11-01, so a repeat rolled from 2026-10-31 to 2026-11-01 crosses it.
